# Board ops status

<!-- Generated by tools/board_ops_status.py. Do not edit by hand:
     run `python3 tools/board_ops_status.py` and commit both this
     file and the .json. -->

What each board port's `eos_board_ops_t` table provides, read from
`boards/*/board_*.c` against `include/eos_hal.h`. The same data is in
[`board-ops-status.json`](board-ops-status.json).

**What this is not.** `C` means the port has code for the operation.
It does not mean the code is correct, and nothing recorded here has
been run on hardware. A board listed here is a port in the tree, not
a supported board.

## Legend

| Mark | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `C` | code | a function whose body this tool does not recognise as one of the stubs below. Whether that body performs the operation is not checked |
| `–` | absent | `NULL` or not named in the table: no port function is called. What the caller sees instead is decided per operation by the wrapper in `hal/hal_core.c`, where there is one, and is not recorded here — some wrappers return an error, some return a default value, and for a `void` operation the caller gets no signal at all |
| `S!` | ok-stub | a function that discards its arguments and returns success — the caller is told the operation happened |
| `E` | err-stub | a function that discards its arguments and returns an error |
| `0` | no-op | a void function with an empty body |
| `K` | const | a function that only returns a fixed non-status value |
| `X` | extern | a function that is not defined in the board file |
